title: Are Trade Size Based Inferences About Traders Reliable? Evidence from Institutional Earnings-Related Trading

requirements.description: Author-specified analysis inputs and complete executable workflow for the paper and supplied appendix. The appendix contains published tables: Tables 3A–9A parallel paper tables for a 2003–2005 sample, and Tables 10–11 add analysis involving announcement-period order imbalance and post-earnings-announcement drift. It describes transactions, orders, position changes, earnings-announcement measures, IBES forecasts, and an Ancerno sample, but the assigned package supplies no underlying analysis data or program. Exact author input files/products, fields, identifiers, full historical coverage, transformations, and the complete main-paper workflow remain unknown. The named sources are not verified acquisition routes and do not establish an access barrier. Obtain the author inputs and specifications; do not independently reconstruct historical sources.

issues.description: The assigned author package contains only an appendix PDF with published tables and descriptions. It contains no runnable author program or entry point for the appendix or the full article workflow.

The appendix identifies selected sample periods, measures, and data references but no README, executable stages, author data files, prescribed software, producer-consumer sequence, or full-paper workflow. Required products/fields/coverage and data construction, access routes, and any alternative branches remain unresolved.

actions.description: Obtain the complete author replication release or an author-approved written substitute for the missing executable workflow, then trace all stages and dependencies.
steps: Request author run instructions, entry and supporting programs/project files, complete author analysis inputs or data-construction specification, and required software/runtime configuration for the main paper and appendix.

After author materials are supplied, trace all mandatory inputs, generated intermediates, cross-language handoffs, and author-defined alternatives; do not infer producers or acquisition steps from appendix tables.

actions.description: Ask which author inputs supply the paper and appendix analysis measures and obtain their exact data and construction specifications.
steps: Request the author-provided input files or author-prepared analysis data used by their workflow, with exact filenames, product/version, format, source columns, identifiers/merge keys, full periods, sample coverage, and transformations.
